_about: The Microsoft Store listing for Vesopa Loyalty's first release (9N6VWPJ25VPH). The first submission has to be typed into Partner Center -- the draft opened by reserving the name refuses a PUT (400) and a fresh POST is refused while it exists (409). This is what was typed, kept so the next person starts from it. Every paragraph is one line: Partner Center shows each newline as a line break.

submission.notesForCertification:
Vesopa Loyalty is the customer-facing loyalty app for venues that use the Vesopa EPOS till system. It is not a general-purpose app: a person signs in as a MEMBER OF A PARTICULAR VENUE'S loyalty scheme.

TO REVIEW IT, please use the demonstration venue:

  1. Start the app. It opens on the sign-in screen for The Vesopa Kitchen.
  2. Enter the email address  manager@vesopa.co.uk
  3. Press "Email me a code". A six-digit code is sent to that address.

Because the reviewer cannot read that mailbox, a standing code has been left in place for certification — please see the "certification sign-in code" line supplied with this submission. Enter it in the six-digit box and press Sign in.

Once signed in you will see the member's card (a QR code the venue's till scans), their points, the Activity list, the Account section and the Venue page. Tapping the card turns it over. The bell at the top right opens the venue's news.

The app talks only to the Vesopa back office over HTTPS (menu.vesopaepos.com). It declares the internetClient capability and nothing else. It handles no payment details of any kind: points are applied by the venue's till, not by this app.

Windows notifications are delivered through WNS using the package identity of this submission. If notifications are not yet configured for the account at review time, messages still appear inside the app — that is by design and not a fault.

listing.description:
Your loyalty card for the venues you already go to — always on you, never in the bottom of a bag.

Show the code at the till and your points go on straight away. Turn the card over to see what those points are worth and how close you are to being able to spend them.

Every visit is listed. Tap one and it opens out: what you spent, what you earned, and the balance it left behind — so a number on a card is always something you can explain.

News and offers from the venue arrive in the app, with pictures and video, and as Windows notifications so you do not miss the ones that matter. Nothing is lost if you would rather not have notifications: every message is still waiting in the app.

Sign in the way your venue offers — an emailed code, a texted code, a password, a passkey using your face or fingerprint, or your Vesopa account. Your venue chooses what it offers; you choose which you use.

Vesopa Loyalty is the app for venues running the Vesopa EPOS till system. Each venue's app carries its own name, logo and colours, so it looks like the place you are in rather than like us.

You need to be a member of a venue's loyalty scheme to sign in. Ask at the venue, or join in the app with your email address if the venue allows it.
